name: kinetic-list
title: Kinetic list
description: A numbered list from a JSON list of strings (up to eight): each item slides in behind a big number in turn, a highlight moves to the newest one and the earlier ones dim; the last stays lit, then the list fades out. An optional title sits above. Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds.

variables.label: Items (JSON list)
variables.default: ["Write the scene in plain HTML","Preview it in the Studio","Render every frame in Chrome","Ship the finished video"]
